description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Professional Services Technical Operations Engineer – Agentic AI based in the United States. 

 We are seeking an innovative and technically skilled Professional Services Technical Operations Engineer specializing in Agentic AI to design, develop, and operate advanced AI-powered systems. In this role, you will build intelligent agent-based solutions that enhance consulting capabilities and streamline internal business operations. You will take ownership of the entire production lifecycle, from gathering stakeholder requirements and designing architectures to security reviews, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Working across engineering, consulting, and leadership teams, you will transform emerging AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and secure production systems. The position offers an opportunity to leverage advanced AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and modern development frameworks to solve complex operational challenges. You will also contribute to AI strategy, technical innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within a highly collaborative, remote-first environment.



Accountabilities:
 

 Lead the end-to-end design, development, deployment, and maintenance of agentic AI systems, ensuring continuous improvement, security, scalability, and operational reliability.

 Translate open-ended business and stakeholder requirements into practical technical solutions and intuitive user experiences, effectively bridging communication between technical and non-technical teams.

 Design and implement multi-agent architectures, prioritizing interoperability, security, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

 Integrate AI agents and LLM-based solutions into production environments, managing agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, and lifecycle operations.

 Establish and maintain performance benchmarks to evaluate agent accuracy, reliability, operational costs, and overall effectiveness, translating results into actionable insights for decision-makers.

 Ensure solutions align with approved service portfolios, existing infrastructure, and organizational approval processes, prioritizing pragmatic implementation over unnecessary greenfield development.

 Advise leadership on AI strategy, emerging technologies, technical roadmaps, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency through agentic AI.

 Mentor team members, encourage knowledge sharing, and promote the adoption of effective AI development and implementation practices.

 Monitor developments in large language models, agentic frameworks, and AI technologies to identify opportunities for continuous innovation.

 Manage production incidents across a broad portfolio of services, including hands-on troubleshooting, incident resolution, and ongoing maintenance of operational runbooks.

 Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support production reliability and respond to critical technical issues.

 Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture decisions, runbooks, and searchable knowledge resources to improve collaboration and preserve organizational knowledge.

 Apply robust validation techniques, including adversarial testing and independent agent reviews, to improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-driven systems and reduce the risk of model-generated errors.


 Requirements:


 Demonstrated experience using AI agents to accelerate complex, multi-step technical workflows, with the ability to direct, evaluate, and refine AI-generated outputs effectively.

 Strong understanding of adversarial validation techniques, including Challenger agents, confidence scoring, mandatory dissent, and other approaches designed to reduce LLM groupthink and improve production reliability.

 Proven experience integrating LLM-based solutions into production environments at scale.

 Hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI framework, such as CrewAI, LangGraph, Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), or an equivalent platform, including agent lifecycle management, tool integration, memory, and orchestration.

 Strong Python development skills, including production-quality coding practices, type hints, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation, with the ability to review and guide AI-generated code.

 Full-stack engineering knowledge and strong systems-thinking abilities, with an understanding of how changes affect applications, services, data pipelines, frontends, and infrastructure.

 Practical experience with REST APIs, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, staged user acceptance testing (UAT), and controlled deployment strategies.

 Working knowledge of AWS cloud services within multi-account production environments, particularly SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3, and IAM.

 Strong technical documentation and knowledge-management skills, with the ability to create clear architecture documentation, operational runbooks, and searchable knowledge systems.

 Ability to work effectively within existing infrastructure, organizational constraints, and approval processes while delivering practical and scalable solutions.

 Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for diverse stakeholders.

 A collaborative and proactive mindset, with a genuine commitment to mentoring colleagues, sharing expertise, and supporting continuous improvement.

 Experience integrating AI-powered solutions with Slack, including bot frameworks, event subscriptions, and slash commands, is highly desirable.

 Familiarity with React and TypeScript frontend development is an advantage but not mandatory.

 Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and take ownership of production operations and incident response.


 Benefits:


 Competitive annual base salary: $120,000–$185,000, depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and work location.

 Eligibility for performance-based bonuses and equity grants.

 Comprehensive healthcare and insurance benefits.

 401(k) retirement savings plan.

 Paid time off and competitive vacation policies.

 Paid parental and adoption leave.

 Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs.

 Professional development and career growth opportunities for employees at all levels.

 Employee resource groups, geographic community networks, and volunteering opportunities.

 Flexible remote working arrangements.

 Access to a collaborative and innovation-driven working environment.

 Opportunities to work with advanced AI technologies, large language models, and agentic systems.

 A culture that encourages experimentation, responsible AI adoption, autonomy, and continuous learning.
